name: nonApi_deleteFcmToken
description: Clears a stale or invalid FCM registration token from HC.Device by setting FcmToken = NULL and stamping FcmTokenDeleted. Called by AppApiHC6, PortalApiHC6, and RunCheckInNotification whenever FCM returns UNREGISTERED or NOT_FOUND for a token. Fire-and-forget — errors are swallowed by callers. Preserves the device row (including location/audit history) rather than deleting it.

parameters.name: fcmToken
parameters.description: The stale FCM registration token to clear. If NULL or empty string, the SP returns immediately with no action. Table column is NVARCHAR(500) NULL.

sideEffects: Sets HC.Device.FcmToken = NULL for the matching device row.
Sets HC.Device.FcmTokenDeleted = SYSUTCDATETIME() for the matching device row.
No-op if @fcmToken is NULL or empty (early return guard).
No-op if no HC.Device row matches the given token (UPDATE affects 0 rows silently).

codeSmells.issue: FcmTokenDeleted column not in extracted table schema
codeSmells.detail: The SP references HC.Device.FcmTokenDeleted, which does not appear in the /db/schema/tables/HC.Device.Table.sql snapshot. This column was likely added after the schema was exported. Callers should be aware it exists in production.

breakingChanges: HC5.hcinternalapi_removeStaleFcmToken performed DELETE FROM HC.Device, destroying the device row. HC6 sets FcmToken = NULL instead, preserving the row. Any code that relied on the device row being deleted after token removal must be updated.
